svg.style: font-family:'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
svg.text: orange window = where rot180(K) sits for the highlighted output
Seen the other way: every dZ[i,j] pushes dZ[i,j] · K back onto the 3×3 patch of the input that produced it,
and where patches overlap the contributions add up. In code: convolve2d(dZ, K, mode='full').
Full padding makes the result as large as the input again; with several filters, sum this over all filters k.
